questions.prompt: Which interpretation best connects the anniversary with the rest of the article?
options: The anniversary introduces a new international title that replaces local conservation arrangements.
The anniversary marks the completion of coastal research and shifts attention towards tourism.
The anniversary celebrates cooperation while explaining the continuing structures and tasks of protection.
The anniversary chiefly records how one council has taken responsibility for the whole coast.
questions.explanationZh: 文章既庆祝合作成果，也解释称号、实际保护及合作管理，并指出保护仍需继续；并非新称号、任务完成或单一议会管理。

questions.prompt: How does the article relate the two distances it gives?
options: Ninety-five miles describes the heritage site; 2,700 miles describes the wider coast path when complete.
Ninety-five miles describes the coast path; 2,700 miles describes the heritage site.
Ninety-five miles describes Dorset’s coastline; 2,700 miles describes the combined heritage sites.
Ninety-five miles describes the anniversary walk; 2,700 miles describes the protected landscapes.
questions.explanationZh: 95英里是本遗产地从Exmouth至Studland Bay的范围；2700英里是整个海岸步道完工后的长度。

questions.prompt: What role is given to Dorset Council and Devon County Council?
options: They provide the geological evidence for the original UNESCO inscription.
They organise all of the scientific research described in the report.
They issue the World Heritage designation for the entire coast.
They coordinate cooperation among a wide range of stakeholders.
questions.explanationZh: s14明确两个议会协调多方合作；未将联合国认定或全部科研交给它们。

questions.prompt: What follows from the distinction about World Heritage status?
options: The site’s habitats are protected only when international visitor numbers remain high.
Understanding protection requires looking at existing designations and planning policies as well as the title.
The two National Landscapes replace the need for cooperation among local organisations.
The title applies to geological features, while wildlife is outside the management described.
questions.explanationZh: 世界遗产地位本身不是英国法定认定，实际保护借助既有认定和规划；这不排除野生生物保护，也不取代合作。

questions.prompt: Which pair of activities belongs to the planned anniversary celebrations?
options: Introducing new statutory sites and extending the heritage boundary.
Opening research laboratories and completing the national coast path.
Cleaning beaches and holding events with local artists.
Counting visitors and selecting new international conservation partners.
questions.explanationZh: 周年计划包括清洁海滩、步行和当地艺术家活动；其他选项把不同背景或未提及的行动混作庆典计划。
